description: Elections Commission - K. L. B. Anaston of the Wanathawilluwa Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of member of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna - M. N. Munasinghe of the Nattandiya Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of the member of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna
reasoning: This gazette contains multiple notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their office as members of Pradeshiya Sabhas (local government bodies) due to ceasing membership in their political parties. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials, falling under the Elections category (Type 7) which includes matters such as candidate registrations, electoral boundary changes, and declarations about elected officials' status.
